Calib.description: Calibration summary sent in `hello` (6.3). The profile itself stays on the phone.
Calib.title: Calib

Check.description: One validator rule outcome (5.2), e.g. {"rule": "R4_preconditions", "ok": true}.
Check.title: Check

CosmosCheck.description:
Request to the verifier (`Verifier.check`). Pre-checks run before a run exists,
so `run_id` may be null; `proposal_id`/`option_id` identify the card instead.
CosmosCheck.title: CosmosCheck

CosmosVerdict.description: Compact Cosmos outcome embedded in a `run` update.
CosmosVerdict.title: CosmosVerdict

EStop.description: Resent every 100 ms until the matching `estop.ack`. Also sent by the presenter.
EStop.title: EStop

EStopReset.description:
Clears the latched stop `estop_seq` (the latest one the phone knows of). Accepted only
from the phone holding the `user` lease (long blink of at least the minimum hold, or a
caregiver touch on that phone) or a `caregiver` phone, identified by `resume_token`.
EStopReset.title: EStopReset

FixedOption.description: Cards the UI always adds, e.g. {"option_id": "none", "label": "None of these"}.
FixedOption.title: FixedOption

FrameRef.description: Which captured frame a check looked at. The image bytes travel separately.
FrameRef.title: FrameRef

Gesture.description: Telemetry: the phone's UI state machine has already acted on the gesture.
Gesture.title: Gesture

Heartbeat.description:
Sent every 100 ms on /ws/safety.

`resume_token` is the token from this phone's `welcome` on /ws/phone. It binds the
heartbeat to the phone session: only the heartbeat of the phone holding the `user` lease
feeds the watchdogs and the R9 face check (a `latched` heartbeat from any device still
counts as a stop). None until the phone has been welcomed.
Heartbeat.title: Heartbeat

Option.description: One card. `label` always comes from the registry (R13); `why` is LLM text, <= 80 chars.
Option.title: Option

Precheck.description: Cosmos pre-check status of one option (5.4).
Precheck.title: Precheck

RunUpdate.description: Progress of the run in flight (`type: "run"`).
RunUpdate.title: RunUpdate

Success.description:
Success estimate shown on a card ("19/20 in tests").

For a plan, `p_est` is the product of in-chain rates (R10), and `n`, `k` and
`wilson_lo` describe the weakest step. `k` is an addition to the design JSON.
Success.title: Success

Thumb.description: Header for the binary JPEG frame that follows it (at most 5 fps).
Thumb.title: Thumb

Transcript.description: ASR result. Also the return type of `ASR.transcribe` (4.2.2).
Transcript.title: Transcript

UiConfirm.description: Confirm of one option. Checked by `validate_confirm` (rule R9).
UiConfirm.title: UiConfirm

UtterStart.description: Start of an utterance. Audio follows as binary frames: [u32 LE utt_id][pcm16le samples].
UtterStart.title: UtterStart

UtterText.description: Typed text in place of speech (caregiver, or mock mode).
UtterText.title: UtterText
